name: Wanli Emperor
contribution: The 14th emperor of the Ming dynasty of China, reigning from 1572 to 1620.
legacy: The country experienced economic and military prosperity, reaching a level of power not seen since the early 15th century
image_credit: Ming Dynasty Imperial Painter · Public domain

checks.lead: The Wanli Emperor (4 September 1563 – 18 August 1620), personal name Zhu Yijun, was the 14th emperor of the Ming dynasty of China, reigning from 1572 to 1620. He succeeded his father, the Longqing Emperor.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
